summary: Linn County, OR L-4 lookout cab built 1934 on the Willamette NF and gone by 1966; newspaper clippings name a lookout there in 1933-1936, and a 2023 visit found no remnants.

facts.status_note: Cab gone by 1966; a 2023 visit report found no remnants of the tower

staffing.status: Paul Ratzeburg named as lookout in newspaper clippings from 1933, 1935 and 1936; the clippings spell the site several ways

access.note: Inferred from the 2023 visit report, which describes dirt Forest Service roads and a small parking area; the report mentions no closure or permit

visit.trail_note: Minimally maintained, unmarked trail that is hard to see; per the 2023 visit report

events.note: Named as one of eleven new emergency lookout stations for the Santiam district; telephone link planned for the next year
Paul Ratzeburg back at work as lookout at 'Mines Rock' (August 1933 clipping), which Forest Lookouts files under Minniece Point
Ratzeburg on lookout duty at 'Minnis Rock' from mid-June (September 1935 clipping)
Ratzeburg's summer lookout work at 'Minne Rock' (July 1936 clipping)
Cab gone by 1966 per the register; firelookout.com says 'Gone 1966'
Registered May 11, 2011 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register
Visit report dated August 4, 2023: no remnants of the tower; rope and two permanent anchors suggest climbers use the site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The clippings spell the place Mines Rock, Minnis Rock and Minne Rock, and Forest Lookouts treats them as Minniece Point. No second source ties them to this site, so the match is that page's identification. Story says so.

notes_for_editor: Built (1934) and gone-by (1966) dates agree between the register and firelookout.com and match the brief's record. The 1931 and 1933-1936 items come from newspaper clippings reproduced by one site, which spells the place three ways; the link to Minniece Point is that site's identification. The 2023 visit report is the only description of the site today. Access level 'public' is an inference from road and parking notes, not a stated rule. No corrections to the record. No new photos found in the sources read.
